gitCommit.subject: fix(sort): Abandon button actually ends the sorting session (purses-nywt) (#226)
gitCommit.body:
fix(sort): Abandon button actually ends the sorting session (purses-nywt) (#226)

* fix(sort): wire the Abandon button to actually end the session (purses-nywt)

The dashboard's Abandon button was a bare <Button> in a Server Component — no
handler, so it did nothing. Replace it with an AbandonSessionButton client island:
two-step confirm (a stray tap can't drop a sort), then DELETE /api/sessions/[id]
(the existing authz'd route soft-deletes -> the session leaves every view) and
router.refresh() so the active-session card disappears.

- Unit: reveal-not-delete, confirm DELETEs + refreshes, back-out is a no-op,
  failed delete shows a gentle message and does not refresh (4 tests).
- E2E (real seam, un-mocked): click Abandon -> confirm -> the card is gone.

- Rename Abandon -> 'Set aside' / 'Set this session aside?' / 'Never mind' (TONE.md
  Commitment 1: no subtraction framing for a gentle, reversible action) [UX major].

  rejection (fetch throws) is caught [QA minor]. 7 unit tests.
